title: スワンSの後に・切り開かれた可能性！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I finally found it! I've found the path that turn me into the ultra strong racer I want to be! I'm a sprinter and miler!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: With today's results in mind, Trainer and I decide to run in G1 sprints and miles next year! I'm determined to be the best at both!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: First up, I'm going to become the champion of sprints! My next goal race is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen in the spring!
